set.body: Port the pure numerical seam of Scala GraphHsmm.run: checked per-unit admissible states and costs, explicit sparse stochastic transitions, positive temperature and uniform initial prior. Produce stable forward/backward posterior marginals, adjacent flow, deterministic Viterbi path and log normalizer. Keep source, distorted, external and unranked meanings explicit; no dense full-source pair allocations. Bind saved results to exact inputs and revalidate copies. Check all outputs against independent three-unit seven-state 343-path enumeration from StructuralWeightSuite, with one-unit, absent-edge, tie, permutation, extreme-cost and malformed-input controls. Center or scale emissions to retain normalized mass under large shared costs; refuse unrepresentable ranges. Require installed API/CLI artifact roundtrip, a targeted mutation and cold numerical review. Supplied transitions only in this slice: graph feature builder, evidence mode gate, refinement, reconstruction, measurement and empirical validation remain owed. See port/docs/roadmap.md, Immediate sequence.
set.title: P4.1 Port sparse sequence inference with exhaustive numerical evidence
